title: Infall Signatures in a Prestellar Core Embedded in the High-mass 70 μm Dark IRDC G331.372-00.116
question: Does the most massive core (ALMA1) in the 70 um dark IRDC G331.372-00.116 show infall and prestellar properties, and what do they imply for competitive accretion versus turbulent core accretion?

data.sensitivity: Continuum rms 0.06 mJy (Cycle 2), 0.1 mJy (Cycle 3); line rms 0.06 K at 0.5 km/s (C2), 0.14 K at 0.08 km/s (C3)

evidence.quote: we have adopted the *Herschel* dust temperature ($T$ = 14 K) determined at the clump scale by (cite: Guzman-2015).
at a distance of 5.4 kpc (cite: Whitaker-2017)
scaling the value of 0.9 cm$^2$ g$^{-1}$ for $\kappa_{1.3 mm}$
a mass ($M$) of $1200$ M$_\odot$[^1] and an effective radius of 0.56 pc

recipe.method: Concatenate 12+7 m, tclean multiscale with Briggs 0.5; lines cleaned with yclean and feathered with TP
Dendrogram on 267 GHz continuum; compare with 2-D Gaussian fit in CASA
key_parameters: threshold 10 x rms, step 1 x rms, min pixels = beam area / pixel size

recipe.method: Optically thin dust mass equation with Planck function

recipe.goal: Linewidths, Mach number and virial parameter
recipe.method: Gaussian fits to N2D+ and DCO+ spectra; sigma_nt from sigma_v^2 = sigma_th^2 + sigma_nt^2; virial mass with density index n = 1.8
Fit Hill5 model to average HCO+ spectrum with PySpecKit/lmfit; Mdot = 4 pi R^2 rho v_in
key_parameters: initial guesses: tau 0.1-30, vlsr -89 to -86.6, vin 0.1-4, sigma 0.3-0.9 km/s, Tpeak 2-30 K
assumptions: Hill5 may underestimate infall velocity, so rate is a lower limit

recipe.goal: Jeans mass, free-fall time and growth
recipe.method: Thermal Jeans mass and free-fall time formulae; extrapolate constant accretion rate
assumptions: constant accretion rate over the free-fall time

evidence.quote: A total of 22 cores are detected above the 5$\sigma$ level

answer_key.quantity: Magnetic field needed for virial equilibrium

not_stated_but_needed: Exact flux of continuum calibrators and flux-scale uncertainty
Image sizes and mosaic phase centers
Which spectra (pixel selection/averaging) define the ALMA1 average HCO+ spectrum
Hill5 fit fixed parameters (e.g. T0) and fit weights
Whether the continuum for dust analysis was primary-beam corrected
Dendrogram region choice for ALMA1 spectral extraction
score_reason: Public data and a fairly detailed recipe with numeric results, but several imaging/extraction details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is largely specified, and the results are numeric (mass, virial parameter, infall rate).
